lines.t: Neon rivers on the floor, I'm walking through your call
Echoes in the humming light, I hear you overall
You say, beloved, come to me, let every burden fall
In this glowing endless night
Your whisper shakes the wall
Every color crashing like a storm inside my chest
You break the pride within my bones
And pull me into rest
Love has saved them, love has saved me
From the shadow and the hunger and the craving to be free
Love has saved them, love has saved me
In the fire of your presence where the blind begin to see
I walked the halls of empty gold
The fame that couldn't stay
A poison tree of vanity
That led my heart astray
But you cut down the branches
Where my ego used to sway
Now your light is flooding in
It turns my night to day
Those who thought they stood so tall are falling at your feet.
Those forgotten in the dark are rising in your heat.
Love has saved them.
Love has saved me.
From the kingdom of pretending and the chains of look at me.
Love has saved them.
Love has saved me.
Now the last are lifted higher in a brighter gravity
Those who are full shall be emptied
So they can taste the feast you pour out endlessly
Those who are last shall be carried
First in the glow of your mercy, finally free
Those with no name shall be honored
We'll be right back.
Every wound is washed in light
Beneath this holy dome
In the center of the storm
Your heart becomes my home
Love has saved them
Love has saved me
From the echo of the grave
And the fear of what I've been
Love has saved them, love has saved me
In the swirling living temple where your glory rushes in
So let the neon heavens ring
Let every color cry
Mercy like an endless wave
Is pouring from the sky
Oh, love has saved them
Love has saved me
And this is why we sing
In the radiance of your truth
Forever glowing king
